01-welcome.title: 1 · Launch the assistant
01-welcome.detail: Chainlit UI on localhost — ask in English or Arabic

02-routing.title: 2 · Router (LangGraph node)
02-routing.detail: Typed RouterDecision: domain + confidence; <0.55 fans out to all domains

03-retrieval.title: 3 · Domain-filtered retrieval
03-retrieval.detail: Qdrant + bge-m3 — 5 chunks, each tied to a real policy file

04-tool.title: 4 · Agent decides, tool answers
04-tool.detail: Agent → typed tool with Pydantic-validated args; one retry on failure

05-cited-answer.title: 5 · Answer with citations
05-cited-answer.detail: Every claim ends in a Sources: list — the locked facts, verbatim

06-arabic.title: 6 · Arabic, same corpus
06-arabic.detail: One index for EN + AR; RTL rendering with citations intact

07-eval.title: 7 · DeepEval grading
07-eval.detail: 10 gold cases × 5 metrics + routing accuracy → outputs/eval_report.json
